headline: EliseAI raises $350M at $4B valuation to automate housing and healthcare
summary: The AI startup, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Ventures, has doubled its valuation in less than a year. Its software is used by 1 in 6 apartments nationwide.
details: AI startup EliseAI has secured $350 million in funding, achieving a $4 billion valuation. This marks a significant increase from its previous valuation last August, effectively doubling its worth.

The funding round was co-led by prominent venture capital firms Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Ventures. EliseAI, founded in 2017, focuses on automating administrative and operational tasks for companies in the housing and healthcare sectors.
EliseAI's platform is currently utilized in 1 in 6 apartments across the United States. The company also announced it has surpassed $200 million in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) this summer.
The company recently introduced Apollo, an AI 'teammate' integrated into the EliseAI platform to assist with leasing, maintenance, and renewals, capable of acting across all property team roles.

On the healthcare side, EliseAI streamlines patient-related paperwork for specialty physician groups, managing processes from initial contact through referrals, scheduling, insurance verification, and follow-up.
EliseAI targets the housing and healthcare industries due to their significant impact on American household expenses, aiming to bring efficiency and automation to these critical areas.
